summary: Onar Holding Corp filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 28, 2026, with purchasers. The company agreed to issue secured convertible promissory notes of up to $15,000,000 with a 10% original issue discount, 8.0% interest, and 18-month maturity. An initial closing issued $3,944,444.44 in notes for $3,550,000 proceeds. Concurrent exchange agreements converted $6,380,385.52 of existing debt into $7,089,317.25 in exchange notes at a 10% premium. Conversion price is fixed at $0.038576 per share based on a $25,000,000 valuation. Watch for Nasdaq uplisting and automatic exchange into Series 1 Preferred Stock.
